stories.name: Oracle Market Forecasts
stories.blurb: A collection of market research reports projecting rapid growth across digital transformation, AI, healthcare IT, and related technology sectors, with Oracle listed among the key vendors profiled.

stories.name: Oracle Stock Slump
stories.blurb: After Oracle's stock plunged to 52-week lows following disappointing earnings, analysts and investors debate whether the sharp decline represents a buying opportunity given Wall Street's bullish price

stories.name: Oracle data center force majeure
stories.blurb: Oracle invoked a force majeure clause on a controversial New Mexico AI data center project, raising investor concerns about delays and costs that sent its stock falling.

stories.name: AI debt bubble
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are warning that massive AI infrastructure spending, increasingly funded by debt and off-balance-sheet commitments, could pose serious credit risks to Big Tech.

stories.name: Adobe stock outlook
stories.blurb: A series of headlines debating whether Adobe's stock is a bargain or still risky as it bets on freemium growth.

past.name: Bloom Energy AI power
past.blurb: Bloom Energy's fuel cell business is surging on AI data center power demand, though questions remain about delayed projects and whether the stock's massive rally can continue.

past.name: Oracle data center delay
past.blurb: Oracle's data center delays and force majeure are weighing on tech stocks amid rising Treasury yields and oil prices.

past.name: Oracle Q1 Earnings Beat
past.blurb: Oracle's fiscal Q1 results topped analyst expectations, driven by surging cloud infrastructure and AI-related demand, prompting raised profit guidance and a jump in its stock price.

7.text: Oracle is named as a vendor in two life-sciences analytics/IT market forecasts, and a new adapter enables PowerPlan-to-Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP data integration. Other items are partner or personnel news: ScaleNorth sponsors Oracle NetSuite's SuiteWorld, and a former Oracle executive joins Ledger Run.

5.text: Oracle shares fell sharply and sit near 52-week lows around $120 support despite 30% revenue growth, 60% cloud growth, and a $664 billion contracted backlog. Analysts reiterate buy ratings, citing discounted valuation and cloud demand, while investors remain unconvinced.

4.text: Oracle is trucking compressed natural gas to AI data centers in Utah and Texas to bypass pipeline delays, and is weighing the same stopgap for New Mexico's 2.45-gigawatt Project Jupiter while urging FERC to expedite its pipeline. Oracle stock fell on rising AI debt, weaker-than-implied OpenAI revenue, and hotter CPI data.

11.text: Hyperscaler capex is projected to near $800 billion in FY2026, driving record debt issuance, wider AI bond spreads (CoreWeave at 15%), and investor anxiety over off-balance-sheet financing. Oracle is barely mentioned; the articles bear on it only as one of the debt-funded AI builders exposed to this repricing.
